A SMALL LAB. A REAL PIPELINE.

Built to explore.
Not to set the market.

The same four frozen models from our capstone project: linear regression, ridge regression, random forest and XGBoost. Their saved preprocessing, feature rules and fitted parameters are preserved.

Predictions use the dataset’s original price units; its currency is unverified. Actual prices appear only for unchanged test examples. New hardware and incomplete specifications can make estimates less reliable.
